title: Create PendingRuleChange SwiftData entity

title: Extend AppGroupConstants with Dashboard V2 keys
Create DeenFirstActivityReport Xcode target
description:
Add a new `DeviceActivityReport` extension target to `Project.swift`.

**Steps:**

1. Add target `DeenFirstActivityReport` to `Project.swift` with bundle ID `$(BASE_BUNDLE_ID).ActivityReport`
2. Add entitlements file with App Group (`group.com.aydev.deenfirst`)
3. Add to App Group in Apple Developer Portal
4. Add `DeenScoreCalculator.swift` and `AppGroupConstants.swift` to this target's membership
5. Verify `NSExtension` info plist key with `com.apple.deviceactivity.report` extension point
6. Verify builds cleanly (no source files yet — just the scaffold)

**Hard constraints for this target:**

* No network calls
* No SwiftData / Core Data
* Read-only App Group (cannot write)
* RAM cap \~100MB
* Use `os_log` not `print()`
* Test on physical device only (simulator unreliable)
* Always include fallback UI

**Acceptance criteria:**

* Target builds without errors
* Extension is in the same App Group as all other targets
* `tuist generate` produces valid Xcode project with the new target

**Blocks:** M5-4 (Dashboard extension UI)

title: Tier 2 (10 min) — sequential two-ayah recitation flow
description:

**Flow:**

1. Load Ayah 1, show progress: "Ayah 1 of 2"
2. User recites → if passes, load Ayah 2 ("Ayah 2 of 2 ✓")
3. User recites Ayah 2 → if passes → grant 10 min access
4. If Ayah 2 fails → retry Ayah 2 only (Ayah 1 result preserved)
5. If Ayah 1 fails → retry Ayah 1 (unlimited retries in Normal Mode)

**In Hard Mode (3 failures on same ayah):** offer Tier 1 downgrade.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* Two distinct ayahs shown sequentially
* Ayah 1 pass state preserved if Ayah 2 fails
* Retry targets only the failed ayah
* 10-min access granted on both passing
* Progress indicator visible ("Ayah 1 of 2")

title: Tier 3 (15 min) — focus session → unblock trigger
description:

**Flow:**

1. User selects Tier 3 → `ActiveSessionView` launched with `isUnblockSession: Bool = true` + `unlockRuleId: UUID`
2. Session plays for 15 min (Normal Mode) or 20 min (Hard Mode)
3. If user ends session early → no access granted, return to Blocking tab
4. If session completes → `SessionService` checks `isUnblockSession` flag → calls `temporaryUnblock(minutes: 15)` after saving session
5. Session saved to history + streak updated normally

**If audio fails to load (no internet):** Show error + offer Tier 1 or Tier 2 instead.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* No access if session ended early
* 15-min access granted on full completion
* Session appears in session history
* Streak updated
* Audio failure fallback offered

title: Unblock timer replacement logic — longer wins
description:
Update `ScreenTimeRulesService+Unblock.swift` to implement "longer wins" logic when a temporary unblock is already active.

**Logic:**

* When `temporaryUnblock(minutes:)` is called:
  * Check if an active unblock exists for this rule (via `unblockExpiryKey`)
  * If existing expiry > (now + newDuration): do nothing, notify user "Your current unblock has more time remaining"
  * If existing expiry <= (now + newDuration): replace with new expiry

**Acceptance criteria:**

* Tier 1 (5 min) does not replace an active 12-min unblock
* Tier 3 (15 min) replaces an active 5-min unblock
* User sees notification when new duration is shorter than current

description:
Update `UnblockDurationSelectionView` and `ReciteToUnblockViewModel` to shift tier requirements when `isHardMode = true`.

| -- | -- | -- |
| Tier 1 (5 min) | 1 ayah | 2 ayahs |
| Tier 2 (10 min) | 2 ayahs | 3 ayahs |
| Tier 3 (15 min) | 15-min session | 20-min session |

Tier requirements must be computed from `rule.isHardMode`, not hardcoded.

```swift
func ayahCount(for tier: UnblockTier, isHardMode: Bool) -> Int {
    switch (tier, isHardMode) {
    case (.tier1, true): return 2
    case (.tier2, true): return 3
    case (.tier1, false): return 1
    case (.tier2, false): return 2
    default: return 0
    }
}
```

title: PendingChangeService — create, cancel, apply, clock check
description:
Create `PendingChangeService.swift` in `Domain/Services/`.

**Methods:**

```swift
func createPendingChange(for rule: ScreenTimeRule, changeType: String, pendingData: Data?) async
func cancelPendingChange(for ruleId: UUID) async
func applyExpiredChanges() async  // called on every foreground
func hasPendingChange(for ruleId: UUID) -> Bool
func pendingChange(for ruleId: UUID) -> PendingRuleChange?
```

**createPendingChange:**

* If a pending change already exists for this rule: replace it (reset 24hr clock)
* Set `appliesAt = requestedAt + 86400`

**applyExpiredChanges:**

* Fetch all non-cancelled, non-applied changes where `appliesAt <= Date.now`
* Clock check: if `Date.now - lastKnownDate > 7200` seconds → log warning, skip, update lastKnownDate, return
* For each expired change: apply via `ScreenTimeRulesService` directly (bypass lock gate)
* Set `isApplied = true`, schedule push notification

**Register in DIContainer.**

**Acceptance criteria:**

* New request replaces existing one for same rule
* applyExpiredChanges applies only truly expired changes
* Clock jump > 2 hours skips auto-apply
* hasPendingChange returns correct state

title: ScreenTimeRulesService — lock editing gate on edit/delete/disable
description:
Add Lock Editing gate to `ScreenTimeRulesService` before any rule modification.

**Gate logic — wrap all mutating operations:**

```swift
func editRule(_ rule: ScreenTimeRule, ...) async {
    guard !rule.isLockEditingEnabled else {
        await pendingChangeService.createPendingChange(for: rule, changeType: "edit", pendingData: encodedRule)
        return
    }
    // existing logic
}
```

**Applies to:** edit, delete, disable (`isEnabled = false`), disableHardMode, disableLockEditing.

**Does NOT apply to:** `temporaryUnblock`, `emergencyUnblock`, creating new rules.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* All 5 gated operations route to PendingChangeService when isLockEditingEnabled = true
* Unblocking and new rule creation unaffected
* Changes applied directly when isLockEditingEnabled = false (existing behaviour preserved)

title: Clock manipulation mitigation in PendingChangeService
description:
Implement best-effort clock manipulation mitigation inside `PendingChangeService.applyExpiredChanges()`.

**Logic:**

```swift
let now = Date.now
let lastKnown = UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: AppGroupConstants.lastKnownDateKey) as? Date ?? now

if now.timeIntervalSince(lastKnown) > 7200 {  // > 2 hour jump
    os_log(.fault, "Clock manipulation suspected: jumped %.0f seconds", now.timeIntervalSince(lastKnown))
    UserDefaults.standard.set(now, forKey: AppGroupConstants.lastKnownDateKey)
    return  // skip auto-apply this cycle
}

UserDefaults.standard.set(now, forKey: AppGroupConstants.lastKnownDateKey)
// proceed with applying expired changes
```

**Note:** This is best-effort only. Sophisticated bypasses (small incremental jumps) are out of scope for V2. Full mitigation requires server-side timestamps (V3).

**Acceptance criteria:**

* System time jump > 2 hours → changes not auto-applied in that cycle
* lastKnownDate updated on every foreground check
* Warning logged via os_log (not print)
* Normal time progression (< 2hr) unaffected

title: AyahPoolService — CRUD, max-20 enforcement, word count filter
description:

**Methods:**

```swift
func fetchPool() async -> [AyahPoolItem]
func addAyah(surahNumber: Int, ayahNumber: Int, arabicText: String, transliteration: String) async throws
func removeAyah(id: UUID) async
func poolCount() async -> Int
func nextAyah(excludeShort: Bool) -> AyahPoolItem?  // excludeShort=true filters wordCount >= 5
func isEmpty() async -> Bool
```

**addAyah:**

* Pre-compute `wordCount` from `arabicText.components(separatedBy: .whitespaces).filter { !$0.isEmpty }.count`
* Enforce max 20 at service layer: throw `AyahPoolError.poolFull` if count >= 20
* Prevent duplicates: throw `AyahPoolError.alreadyInPool` if same surah+ayah exists

**nextAyah:** Sequential or random selection (TBD by implementer). If `excludeShort=true`, filter to `wordCount >= 5`.

**Register in DIContainer.**

**Acceptance criteria:**

* addAyah throws when pool is at 20
* wordCount pre-computed and stored (not recomputed)
* nextAyah respects excludeShort filter
* No duplicates allowed

title: DeenScoreCalculator — pure function in Shared/
description:
Create `DeenScoreCalculator.swift` in `deenfirst/Sources/Shared/`. Must be added to **both** the main app target and `DeenFirstActivityReport` extension target.

**Input struct:**

```swift
struct DeenScoreInput {
    let quranSeconds: Int
    let focusSessions: Int
    let recitationsPassed: Int
    let streakDays: Int
    let screenTimeOverLimitSeconds: Int
    let emergencyUnblocksThisWeek: Int
}
```

**Formula (base 50):**

```swift
func calculateDeenScore(_ input: DeenScoreInput) -> Int  // pure, returns 0–100
```

**All weights as named constants in** `ScoreWeights` enum — no magic numbers.

Score formula:

* Quran time: <10min=+5, <20=+10, <30=+15, 30+=+20
* Focus sessions: 1=+10, 2+=+15
* Recitations: 1=+5, 3+=+10
* Streak active: +5, streak>=7: +5 bonus
* Over limit 30min: -10, 60min: -20, 90min: -30
* Emergency unblock: 1=-5, 2=-10
* Clamp to 0–100

**Acceptance criteria:**

* Pure function (no side effects, no external dependencies)
* All weights named constants
* Score clamped to 0–100
* File compiles in both targets

title: Dashboard extension UI — Quran vs Screen Time comparison + Weekly Trend
description:

title: Dashboard tab host view — thin wrapper with date selector and fallback
description:
Replace the stub `DashboardTabView` (created in DF-11) with the real implementation.

**This is a thin host view** — all content is rendered by the extension.

**Contents:**

* `DeviceActivityReport` view (extension renders inside it)
* Date context passed to extension: "Today" or "This Week" picker
* Loading state while extension initializes
* Fallback message if extension fails: "Score loading... Pull down to refresh." — never a blank/black screen

**Critical:** The extension is known to crash silently showing a black screen. Always wrap in a container with the fallback message visible behind it.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* DeviceActivityReport extension renders inside the tab
* Date selector visible and passes context to extension
* Fallback message shown if extension fails (not blank/black)
* Loading state shown during initialization

title: Unit tests — DeenScoreCalculator
description:
Write unit tests for `DeenScoreCalculator` covering all score formula branches.

**Test cases:**

* Base score = 50 with no activity
* Max score: 30+ min Quran + 2 sessions + 3+ recitations + 7-day streak = 100 (clamped)
* Min score: 90+ min over limit + 2 emergency unblocks + no Quran = 0 (clamped)
* Each positive contribution in isolation
* Each negative deduction in isolation
* Boundary values (exactly 10min, 20min, 30min Quran; exactly 30min, 60min, 90min over limit)
* Score never exceeds 100 or goes below 0

**Acceptance criteria:**

* All formula branches covered
* Boundary values tested
* Floor/ceiling clamping tested
* Tests are pure (no mocks needed — pure function)

title: Unit tests — PendingChangeService
description:
Write unit tests for `PendingChangeService`.

**Test cases:**

* createPendingChange: creates record with appliesAt = requestedAt + 86400
* createPendingChange: replaces existing pending change for same rule (resets clock)
* cancelPendingChange: marks change as cancelled, hasPendingChange returns false
* applyExpiredChanges: does not apply non-expired changes
* applyExpiredChanges: applies expired changes and sets isApplied = true
* Clock mitigation: time jump > 2 hours skips apply
* Clock mitigation: normal progression (< 2 hours) applies correctly

* hasPendingChange: returns false after cancel

title: Unit tests — AyahPoolService
description:
Write unit tests for `AyahPoolService`.

**Test cases:**

* addAyah: adds item successfully when pool < 20

* addAyah: throws alreadyInPool for duplicate surah+ayah
* addAyah: wordCount pre-computed correctly from arabicText
* removeAyah: removes item, poolCount decrements

title: Integration tests — Tiered Unblock flows (T1, T2, T3)
description:
Write integration tests covering the full Tiered Unblock flows.

**Test scenarios:**

**Tier 1:**

* Pass: score >= 70% → 5-min unblock granted
* Fail: score < 70% → retry offered, no access granted
* Shorter-wins: Tier 1 does not replace active 8-min unblock

**Tier 2:**

* Pass both: Ayah 1 + Ayah 2 both pass → 10-min unblock
* Fail Ayah 2: Ayah 1 preserved, Ayah 2 retry only
* Fail Ayah 1: Full restart from Ayah 1

**Tier 3:**

* Complete 15-min session → 15-min unblock + session saved to history
* End early → no unblock, return to Blocking tab
* Audio failure → Tier 1/2 fallback offered

**Acceptance criteria:**

* All 8 scenarios covered
* Unblock expiry times correct
* Session history verified for Tier 3
* Longer-wins logic verified

title: Integration tests — Hard Mode + Lock Editing interaction
description:
Write integration tests for Hard Mode and Lock Editing interaction.

**Hard Mode tests:**

* Enabling Hard Mode sets isLockEditingEnabled = true
* 85% threshold enforced (75% fails)
* Refresh Ayah button absent in Hard Mode
* Ayahs < 5 words never shown in Hard Mode
* Tier 1 requires 2 ayahs in Hard Mode

**Lock Editing tests:**

* Edit attempt on locked rule → PendingChangeSheet shown (no editor)
* Delete attempt on locked rule → PendingChange created
* Cancel pending change → change removed, hasPendingChange = false
* After 24hr expiry (mocked time) → change applied
* Turning Lock Editing OFF → goes through 24hr delay

**Combined:**

* Hard Mode ON → Lock Editing auto-ON
* Hard Mode OFF attempt → blocked by Lock Editing delay

**Acceptance criteria:**

* All 11 scenarios covered
* Time mocking used for expiry tests
